name: BSP_PlaneBot_ApproachBaseStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_airfield_taxi, read-only analysis. __thiscall(task, float dt), RET 4, body 009B22C0-009B2C68. Ghidra has no function here; the vtable 00D1FF60 holds it at slot +0Ch. The sibling of 009CD540 for a plane heading to a base it is not yet attached to: the target site comes from the context at (task+4)+34h rather than plane+BF4h, and it fails only when the plane is already attached (byte plane+BF8h set and plane+BF4h non-null) and that target's owner is dead. Reads the queue origin through site->vtable[44h] = 006CF520, keeps its Z, then the taxi target through site->vtable[2Ch] = 006CF420, and runs the identical 4-to-5 switch at 009B271A-009B273A. Coverage: partial, only the head, the switch and the queue read were reduced. docs/AIRFIELD_TAXI.md

name: BSP_BotStateMoveTo_SetRanges
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_torpedo_moveto_tick, read-only, complete. void __thiscall(state, float a, float b, float c): three stores into state+30h, +34h and +38h and nothing else. Its torpedo call site passes (approach+3Ch + approach+34h, the same value again, task+438h), so both altitude slots carry the task's aim altitude - docs/BOT_TASK_STATES.md line 262 identifies the depth charge's twin as a draw between Pilot/DepthCharge/AimAltRange/1 = 20 and /2 = 60 - and +38h carries the distance at which the glide slope is to reach it. The tick 009C18C0 uses +34h and +30h as max(this+34h + targetY, this+30h), the glide's base altitude, and +38h as 009FBA50's rangeLow, which REFUTES docs/BOT_TASK_STATES.md's reading of 009C2AC0's constructor parameters as near/far/mode: the last is a distance, not a mode. docs/TORPEDO_MOVETO_TICK.md.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_Enter_Provisional
evidence: PROVISIONAL. Packet cc8_formation, read only for its one formation call. Callees 0042E740 BSP_GameTuning_GetSingleton, 00694A60 BSP_Observer_RegisterPair, 006952A0 BSP_Observer_UnregisterPair, 007ED260 and 009BE150; callers 009C7240 BSP_BotStateDiveBombDone_Enter and 009D2530 BSP_BotStateTorpedoDone_Enter. Its call to 007ED260 is what assigns the squadron's formation indices, so a wing gets its stations when the follow state is entered and not at spawn: 007D01C3 zeroes plane+9D0h in the plane constructor and 007F4B43 never writes it. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md. | CORRECTION (same packet): this is not the only site that assigns the indices. tools/callsite_census.py 007ed260 returns nine call sites, including 007F4BFA inside the spawn tail 007F4580, so a wing has its indices from spawn; 009BEDE4 re-runs the assignment on the follow entry.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_UpdateStationPoint
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_formation, read from the listing, complete. __fastcall(state /*ECX*/), body 009BFD70-009BFED6, 108 instructions. The first half of the follow tick 009C1FD0. 009BFD76 ECX=[state+4] the task context; 009BFD84 EAX=[[ECX+0Ch]+3D0h], the squadron's member array slot 0 = the flight leader, JZ out when either is null; 009BFD92 CMP EAX,[ECX+4] / JZ 009BFEB1, so the flight leader does not follow itself; 009BFDA1 006CEF40(state+18h, leader); 009BFDA6-009BFDB2 [squadron+3E8h] = [state+8Ch], the morale republish; 009BFDBE MOV ECX,[[ECX+4]+9D0h], the unit's own formationIndex, pushed with EBP=state+30h and ECX=squadron into 009BFDCC CALL 007F23A0. 009BFDEE-009BFE19 then takes the vector from the unit's own world position (unit+0FCh..104h) to the station and its length through 0042B2F0, and 009BFE24 compares it with [[state+6Ch]+18h]. Sole caller 009C1FD0 at 009C1FEA. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_StationKeepingStep_Provisional
evidence: PROVISIONAL and NOT READ. Packet cc8_formation named it from its position only: it is the second call of the follow tick 009C1FD0 (at 009C1FF?), immediately after 009BFD70 has produced the wing member's station. Body 009BFEE0-009C1846, 1795 instructions, 210 basic blocks, 297 edges, 55 calls, cyclomatic complexity 89. Hypothesis, on the size and the Pilot/Follow tuning block that surrounds it, that it is the law that flies a member to the station (GoodPositionDist, GoodPositionDir, NearbyDist, WaitForHdgDiff, LeaderHeadingSpdTime/Dist, TightTurn and the yf_/pf_/rf_/pwr_ gains). No line of it was read; the name must not be relied on. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md section 5.
